name: Carpentry
summary: Interior and exterior carpentry for remodeling, repairs and finish upgrades, including trim, doors, framing, cabinets, built-ins and damaged wood replacement.
features: Baseboards, crown molding and interior trim
Exterior wood, fascia and soffit repairs

faqs.question: Do you handle both finish carpentry and framing repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes. A project can include visible finish work such as trim and doors as well as framing repairs, blocking and wall modifications when required by the approved scope.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim profiles?
faqs.answer: We inspect the existing profile and source the closest practical match. When an exact profile is unavailable, we explain the available options before installation.

faqs.question: Can you install prehung and slab doors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Door work can include prehung units, slab replacement, casing, hardware, alignment and finish preparation, depending on the opening and project conditions.

faqs.question: Do you build custom shelves or built-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can build or install shelving, storage, cabinet components and other practical built-in features based on measurements, materials and the final design.

faqs.question: Can carpentry repairs be included in a larger remodel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Carpentry can be coordinated with drywall, painting, flooring, cabinets, doors and other trades so the work is completed as one organized project.
